title: Preserve native Ctrl/Cmd+Shift transcript selection-boundary gestures
outcome: The current message-stack shortcut routing captures Ctrl+Shift+Home/End on Windows/Linux and Cmd+Shift+Home/End on macOS, preventing the browser's standard select-to-document-boundary behavior inside the transcript. Decide the intended shortcut contract, preserve native selection extension when appropriate, and add platform-aware interaction coverage. Deferred with the user's scroll/UI work; do not mix into the current Stop/mailbox backend fix.
